  "title": "Merchant Onboarding Support Officer",
  "description": "Moniepoint Incorporated is a global business payments and banking platform and recently became QED Investors&rsquo; first investment in Africa. We are the partner of choice for over 600,000 businesses of all sizes, powering the dreams of SMBs and providing them with equal access to the tools they need to grow and scale.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:&nbsp;

&nbsp;Job Position: Merchant Onboarding Support Officer

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview


	The Merchant Onboarding team is responsible for ensuring that merchants, whether self-signed or referred by the sales team, are efficiently converted into active, transacting customers in the shortest possible time, while maintaining full adherence to regulatory compliance requirements and delivering a seamless onboarding experience.


Core Operational Responsibilities


	Review Merchant&rsquo;s KYC and ensure all documents provided are in line with Standard Operating Procedures and Regulatory Requirements.
	Work with the Compliance team in activation of Merchant&rsquo;s accounts.
	Reviewing Logged tickets by the Customer Support team and ensuring complete resolution of such tickets.
	Monitor Support Channels (Zendesk, E-mails, Whatsapp, Teams and Slack) for
	Onboarding/Integration escalations, and treat such requests in a timely manner.
	Liaise with the sales team to properly understand the Merchant&rsquo;s use case in order to provide the necessary API&rsquo;s required for Merchant&rsquo;s Integration.
	Follow up with Merchants (Bi-weekly-Semi) to check in on their Integration and provide assistance/support where necessary.
	Work hand in hand with other teams i.e technical product team to escalate technical issues experienced by merchants and also monitor such requests till resolution.
	Configure Merchant fees and charging profiles. Also enabling changes to merchant contracts as advised by the sales team.
	Work with the Product Manager/ Product team and other internal stakeholders to make any product changes that would improve customer experience.
	Business information changes (settlement account, fees, email, phone number etc.).


Expected Skills:


	Payments &amp; Fintech Knowledge -Familiarity with regulatory environments (especially in Nigeria) , Payment gateways, APIs, and transaction flows.
	Analytical &amp; Problem-Solving Skills- Diagnose onboarding failures, Identify patterns in merchant issues and Escalate intelligently with context.
	CRM tool expert skills-Excel / Google Sheets (advanced level), Zendesk, E-mails, WhatsApp, Teams and Slack.
	Educational Background -Fintech (strongly preferred), Banking / payments operations, SaaS onboarding or customer success and Compliance/KYC operations
	Technical Capability- Basic to intermediate understanding of: APIs endpoints, authentication keys, Webhooks, JSON responses, ability to read API documentation and Support merchants during integration to support in the preliminary integration phase.


Execution Capability skills:


	Risk &amp; Compliance Awareness skills
	Cross-Functional Collaboration Skills
	Candidate selection/ Great candidate; will have
	Fintech exposure
	Basic API understanding
	Strong communication.
	Operational discipline
	KYC &amp; Compliance awareness.

Merchant Onboarding Support Officer Job at Moniepoint




        
    

        
        Moniepoint Incorporated is a global business payments and banking platform and recently became QED Investors’ first investment in Africa. We are the partner of choice for over 600,000 businesses of all sizes, powering the dreams of SMBs and providing them with equal access to the tools they need to grow and scale.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Merchant Onboarding Support Officer

Job Location: Lagos

Role Overview
     

            
    




	The Merchant Onboarding team is responsible for ensuring that merchants, whether self-signed or referred by the sales team, are efficiently converted into active, transacting customers in the shortest possible time, while maintaining full adherence to regulatory compliance requirements and delivering a seamless onboarding experience.


Core Operational Responsibilities


	Review Merchant’s KYC and ensure all documents provided are in line with Standard Operating Procedures and Regulatory Requirements.
	Work with the Compliance team in activation of Merchant’s accounts.
	Reviewing Logged tickets by the Customer Support team and ensuring complete resolution of such tickets.
	Monitor Support Channels (Zendesk, E-mails, Whatsapp, Teams and Slack) for
	Onboarding/Integration escalations, and treat such requests in a timely manner.
	Liaise with the sales team to properly understand the Merchant’s use case in order to provide the necessary API’s required for Merchant’s Integration.
	Follow up with Merchants (Bi-weekly-Semi) to check in on their Integration and provide assistance/support where necessary.
	Work hand in hand with other teams i.e technical product team to escalate technical issues experienced by merchants and also monitor such requests till resolution.
	Configure Merchant fees and charging profiles. Also enabling changes to merchant contracts as advised by the sales team.
	Work with the Product Manager/ Product team and other internal stakeholders to make any product changes that would improve customer experience.
	Business information changes (settlement account, fees, email, phone number etc.).


Expected Skills:


	Payments & Fintech Knowledge -Familiarity with regulatory environments (especially in Nigeria) , Payment gateways, APIs, and transaction flows.
	Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills- Diagnose onboarding failures, Identify patterns in merchant issues and Escalate intelligently with context.
	CRM tool expert skills-Excel / Google Sheets (advanced level), Zendesk, E-mails, WhatsApp, Teams and Slack.
	Educational Background -Fintech (strongly preferred), Banking / payments operations, SaaS onboarding or customer success and Compliance/KYC operations
	Technical Capability- Basic to intermediate understanding of: APIs endpoints, authentication keys, Webhooks, JSON responses, ability to read API documentation and Support merchants during integration to support in the preliminary integration phase.


Execution Capability skills:


	Risk & Compliance Awareness skills
	Cross-Functional Collaboration Skills
	Candidate selection/ Great candidate; will have
	Fintech exposure
	Basic API understanding
	Strong communication.
	Operational discipline
	KYC & Compliance awareness.

Business Development Executive Job at Moontech Real Estate




        
    

        
        Moontech Real Estate is a leading real estate and property technology company operating under Moontech Group, committed to helping individuals and investors make informed, secure, and rewarding property decisions. The company combines Real Estate expertise with innovation and technology to deliver modern property solutions tailored to the needs of homeowners, investors, and businesses.
     

            
    



With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, integrity, innovation, leadership, and excellence, Moontech Real Estate provides clients with professional guidance throughout the property acquisition and investment process. Its services cover property sales, land and property investment, off-plan developments, property advisory, site inspections, and other Real Estate solutions designed to make property ownership and investment more accessible and seamless.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Business Development Executive

Job Location: Guzape, Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Responsibilities


	Generate new leads and identify prospective clients through networking, referrals, cold calling, digital platforms, events, and other business development activities.
	Contact, engage, and follow up with prospective clients to understand their real estate needs and investment interests.
	Promote and market the company's properties and Real Estate investment opportunities.
	Schedule and coordinate site inspections and property presentations for prospective clients.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, investors, affiliates, and other relevant stakeholders.
	Identify, recruit, and onboard potential affiliates and business partners to support sales growth.
	Follow up consistently with leads and prospects to improve conversion rates.
	Achieve assigned weekly and monthly sales and business development targets.
	Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, follow-ups, site inspections, affiliates, and sales activities on the company's designated CRM or reporting platform.
	Conduct market research and monitor real estate trends, competitor activities, and potential business opportunities.
	Prepare and submit timely daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports.
	Attend team meetings, trainings, site inspections, and other official company activities as required.
	Represent Moontech Real Estate professionally and maintain a high standard of customer service.
	Perform other duties assigned by the management in line with the role.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Business Development Executive Application” as the subject of the email
